titulo: Learjet Dives 35,000 ft - "We Are Out of Ten" #Shorts
descripcion:
The last minute of N722BD, a Learjet 60, over Palm Beach County on 1 November 2026: the recorded ADS-B track replayed in a flight simulator with the real Miami Center audio.

Full replay: https://youtu.be/yUxIiKR3c14

ATC audio: LiveATC.net archives, used under license. The aircraft shown is a simulator stand-in; attitude and forces are derived from the recorded track and are approximate. This is a data visualization, not an investigation finding. The NTSB investigation (ERA27MA026) is open.

#Shorts #aviation #ATC
